draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.60, the 242nd-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 19th of 20 at S. He went 204th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (242nd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2021) ranked 2nd in tackles among the 19 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Minnesota Vikings. 57 career games and 8 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (5 AV) was his best yet. Weak spots: interceptions 0 (22nd percentile), passes defended 1 (22nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 safety who played: 49.5% season snap share against a median of 72.3%, below the norm.
